working_definition: Author type 'T4b' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).

best_match.fbbt_definition: T4 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 2 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in a diagonal back-to-front direction (Henning et al., 2022).

justification: 'T4b' is the exact label or an exact synonym of FBbt:00003733 'T4b neuron'.
